top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation reduces to a defined chemical event, small-molecule-enforced proximity between a target and an E3 ligase, which has been shown in vitro, in cells and structurally and reproduced by many independent groups. Crews and Deshaies conceived the PROTAC and Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, so the trio covers both founding branches under one stated principle. Maturity rests on mechanistic confirmation rather than an approved drug, which I cannot verify; the allocation excludes Ciulli and others and is a contestable judgement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my nucleotide-metabolism work is adjacent to ubiquitin-dependent protein turnover but I have no collaboration with any credited candidate
